# Xero

Accounting · options checked 2026-10-21 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Xero publishes its own tools for AI agents. Start with those.**

No vendor-published skills. Xero publishes an official MCP server (51 tools, including create-payment and manual journals, no confirmation step) and example agents (xero-agent-toolkit); both indexed.

## What to use

### From Xero

- **[Xero MCP Server](../../skills/xero-mcp-server/README.md)** — MCP server · Changes records without asking first · needs Xero custom connection or bearer token · [source](https://github.com/XeroAPI/xero-mcp-server/tree/main)
  Xero's official MCP server: 51 tools over invoices, contacts, payments, bank transactions, manual journals, payroll timesheets and reports (P&amp;L, balance sheet, trial balance, aged receivables and payables).
- **[Xero Agent Toolkit](../../skills/xero-agent-toolkit/README.md)** — Developer toolkit · Changes records without asking first · needs Xero MCP Server credentials · [source](https://github.com/XeroAPI/xero-agent-toolkit/tree/main)
  Xero's example agents (LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK) built on the Xero MCP Server.
